notes.title: Release notes 2025-03-30
notes.content:
- Darts game scoreboard update logic optimizations

- Dice game scoreboard update logic optimizations

- Darts game and Dice game: Added Round column to scoreboard

notes.title: Release notes 2025-02-09
notes.content:
- Plastic duck fight and Chicken fight games settings: Round length can be set between 3-15 minutes

- Plastic duck fight game attack and collect commands have now 2 seconds cool down

- Plastic duck fight game has now automatic simulation mode in settings. Feature means that if setting is enabled and player is not writing attack or collect commands to chat game itself randomly send attack or collect commands for idle players. Automatic simulation works if there are more than 2 players.

- Chicken fight game has now automatic simulation mode in settings. Feature means that if setting is enabled and player is not writing attack or collect commands to chat game itself randomly send attack or collect commands for idle players. Automatic simulation works if there are more than 2 players.

notes.title: Release notes 2025-02-02
notes.content:
- Plastic duck fight and Chicken fight: Respawn player after death within the same round setting is now by default enabled

- Plastic duck fight game scoreboard update logic optimization

- Darts game scoreboard update logic optimization

- Dice game scoreboard update logic optimization

- Chicken fight game scoreboard update logic optimization

- Chicken fight game death collider fixes

- Chicken fight game: collect and attack forward vector calculation fix if command is executed right away from spawning

- Chicken fight game: Added new golden egg with double points

notes.title: Release notes 2025-01-26
notes.content:
- Graphics quality level settings added (Very low, low, Medium, High, Very high and Ultra)

- FPS limit setting added (30 vs 60 fps)

- Dice game events text alignment changes

- Settings menu can be close by pressing Escape key

- Plastic duck fight scoreboard update logic optimization

notes.title: Release notes 2025-01-25
notes.content:
Chicken fight game improvements:

- If (Attack, Collect or Run) command is running. Other commands does not have effect if user try to execute other commands at the same time

- Player name color changes


Plastic duck fight game improvements:

- Game logic optimizations

- Plastic duck has now spawn safe cooldown time (5 seconds) if other player try to kill right away after spawn

- New setting: Respawn player after death within the same round.

- Spawn area is now larger

- Plastic duck fight hot tub edition: Spawn area bug fixes

- Plastic duck fight hot tub edition: events text alignment changes

- Events text maximum rows changed from 5 to 10

- Game HUD font color changes

- Player name color changes

- Sound pitch is now little bit random

notes.title: Release notes 2025-01-18
notes.content:
Chicken fight game improvements:

- Chicken fight game HUD alignment changes

- Added ambience sound to Chicken fight game

- Chicken fight game spawn area is now larger

- Chicken has now spawn safe cool down time (5 seconds) if other player try to kill right away after spawn

- New run command to move chicken to random direction

- Collect command: chicken now moves a longer distance

- New setting for Chicken fight game: Re-spawn player after death within the same round.

- Chicken fight game player name text size is smaller

- Attack, Collect and run command cannot spam in the chat if it is currently running. Subsequent same chat command does not have effect.
